claim: Initializing a new head-only consumer decoder from the retained head decoder was tested without replay and did not improve stable-prefix sample efficiency.
retention_on_mastered_primitives: The original head decoder and frozen head program remained unchanged and reloadable; the shared controller digest was unchanged.
reason_rejected: The retained decoder prior reached 0.83984375 but required 22528 stable verifier bits versus 16384 for the fresh decoder baseline, so its early endpoint advantage was not stable mastery.
